papers.title_en: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
papers.authors: Wei Liu, Min Gao, Yali Du, Yulan He
papers.evidence: 利用环境生成轨迹构建智能体训练数据
papers.tldr: 面向数据分析的智能体通常需要大量人工标注任务才能学会与数据库等可执行环境交互。EnvLunch提出一种无标注预热阶段：采样合法动作轨迹并执行得到最终观测，再训练模型仅凭最终观测重建功能等价的轨迹，把环境本身当作免费的任务来源。该预热在各类下游训练预算下平均超过基线9分以上，少标签时基线需8至32倍标注样本才能达到同等精度。其意义在于节省标注成本，并为智能体微调提供更优起点。
papers.abstract_en: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.

papers.title_en: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.authors: Tao Ren, Hui Yang, Jia Deng, Tingyang Chen, Qiyao Wang, Shuo Tang, Ziyang Zeng, Yuhua Jiang, Guanghao Li, Huatong Song, Yining Li, Yifan Luo, Kunbao Ding, Feng Chang, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai, Jiafeng Liang, Jinyang Jiang
papers.evidence: 面向长时程语言模型智能体工具使用的回合级强化学习优化
papers.tldr: 长程LLM智能体按完整对话轮次与环境交互，却逐token生成动作，导致信用分配粒度不匹配。作者提出多尺度策略优化MPO，结合多尺度优势估计MAE与轮次级重要性采样，使信用分配和策略更新在轮次尺度对齐。在搜索、工具使用和自动化任务上，4B与30B-A3B模型均稳定优于强RL基线。该工作为长程智能体强化学习提供了更契合轮次结构的优化框架。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with their environments through complete assistant turns while generating each action token by token. We observe that critic values vary primarily across turns, motivating optimization anchored at turns with finer credit allocation among tokens. We propose Multiscale Policy Optimization (MPO), combining Multiscale Advantage Estimation (MAE) and turn-level importance sampling to align credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale. Extensive experiments across search, tool-use, and automation tasks with 4B and 30B-A3B models demonstrate consistent gains over strong RL baselines.

papers.title_en: Action-Value Calibration via Continuation Sharing for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yingjian Chen, Lang Zhou, Zixin Zhao, Pingfan Li, Weishi Zheng, Zhilin Zhao
papers.evidence: 长时程智能体强化学习与多步交互信用分配
papers.tldr: 长程智能体强化学习因反馈来自交互序列而难以对单个动作做信用分配；GiGPO等共享状态比较方法仅用单条采样延续估计动作价值，局部信用易受后续决策干扰。ConCal递归利用同批次中同一任务的共享延续证据，按状态-动作-状态转移匹配访问，融合自身转移估计并将校准价值反向传播以修正早期动作价值。在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上，ALFWorld和WebShop成功率分别较GiGPO提升3.39和5.86个百分点。该方法无需额外rollout即可降低对单条采样延续的依赖，缓解局部信用扭曲。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on feedback from sequences of interactions, making credit assignment to individual actions difficult. Existing methods such as GiGPO compare actions at shared states to compute relative advantages, but estimate each action's value from a single sampled continuation. The resulting local credit remains sensitive to decisions made later in the trajectory. To address this problem, we propose ConCal (Continuation Calibration), a recursive continuation-value estimator that incorporates continuation evidence already present in a rollout batch. ConCal matches visits from the same task by their incoming state-action-state transitions, combines shared continuation evidence with each visit's own transition estimate, and propagates calibrated values backward to refine earlier action-value estimates. This reduces dependence on individual sampled continuations and mitigates local credit distortions without additional rollouts. Held-out return diagnostics show lower error in within-group value differences and higher agreement with reference action orderings than estimates based on individual continuations. With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, ConCal improves success rates over GiGPO by 3.39 and 5.86 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yingjian-Chen/ConCal.

papers.title_en: Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
papers.authors: Andrew Szot, Samira Abnar, Omar Attia, Abbas Kazerouni, Michael Kirchhof, Cheng-Yu Hsieh, Raviteja Vemulapalli, Alexander Toshev
papers.evidence: 面向工具使用智能体数据构成的可控合成环境
papers.tldr: 针对LLM工具使用智能体在复杂多步任务中训练数据如何影响泛化的问题，作者提出SynthAPI流水线，可控生成在工具、任务与数据库多样性上不同的合成环境。通过四种模型规模、849个模型和458752个任务系统变化生成控制，推导出预测下游泛化的缩放律。结果表明数据预算增大时，扩展工具与数据库多样性比单纯增加任务数更有效，提升数据复杂度收益更大；据此训练的智能体在四个评测基准上优于先前方法。
papers.abstract_en: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use environments affects the training of such agents. To do so, we propose the SynthAPI pipeline, which explicitly controls the diversity of generated environments along the axes of tools, tasks, and the databases on which the tools operate. By systematically varying SynthAPI's generation controls in 458,752 tasks across 849 trained models of four different sizes, we derive a scaling law that predicts downstream tool-use agent generalization based on the scale and composition of the synthesized environments. These predictable relationships reveal several lessons for scaling tool-use agent data. As data budgets grow, scaling tool and database diversity becomes more effective than increasing the number of tasks, and increasing data complexity yields larger gains. Scaling according to these findings yields agents that outperform models trained on data from prior work in large-scale tool-use agent and synthetic environment generation across four evaluation benchmarks.

papers.authors: Shufan Shen, Zhongni Hou, Chao Bi, Yufei Zhang, Guojun Yin, Shuhui Wang
papers.evidence: 在线自蒸馏，用当前策略轨迹训练学生
papers.tldr: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）用特权上下文提示的自教师对齐学生模型词级分布，缓解序列级后训练奖励稀疏问题，但训练中难以持续提升。本文发现根源在于模型自教学能力有限，部分样本给出不可靠指导。为此提出教师进化自蒸馏TESD：让自教师生成轨迹并接收基于任务正确性与上下文独立性的环境反馈，先以这些奖励对教师做定向优化，持续增强自教学能力；再由奖励估计指导可靠性，对学生做自适应优化，降低不可靠样本权重。多数据集多规模实验表明TESD稳定优于代表性token级与序列级方法，说明提升OPSD监督质量十分必要。
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model scales show that TESD consistently outperforms representative token-level and sequence-level methods, highlighting the necessity of improving supervision quality in OPSD.

papers.title_en: MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents
papers.authors: Shengqin Wang, Jie Jin, Xiaofan Li, Wentao Yan, Yu Cheng, Qingsong HuYihang Chen, Weilin Luo, Jingyu Gong, Xin Tan, Yuan Xie, Zhizhong Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向多模态工具智能体的多角色协作强化学习
papers.tldr: 多模态工具智能体需借助外部工具解决知识密集与视觉复杂任务，但现有强化学习流程多只训练单一角色，用终端奖励完成搜索与作答，忽视了人类检索证据、改写查询、修正结论的自我纠错过程。MRC-MMAgent提出多角色协同强化学习框架，把求解、检查与续接组成可执行闭环，并引入角色耦合学习目标联合优化任务成功、交互有效性与纠错成功。实验在原始基线训练集上即稳定超越对应基座模型，多个基准达到领先或极具竞争力的表现。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
papers.authors: Sriyash Poddar, Yanda Bao, Jacob Krantz, Matthew Chang, Xavier Puig, Roozbeh Mottaghi, Natasha Jaques, Abhishek Gupta
papers.evidence: 利用学生同策略上下文的非对称同策略蒸馏
papers.tldr: 部分可观测序贯决策需探索隐藏信息，但在线强化学习样本效率低，离线模仿又难以学到探索。ASTEROID采用学生-教师监督：学生按自身策略收集在线上下文，特权专家基于该上下文给出动作标签，蒸馏出“不确定时搜索、揭示后利用”的测试时探索。在11类环境取得约2倍回报、约100倍更少交互，并迁移到真实机器人。
papers.abstract_en: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student's on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ~2x higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses ~100x fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by +40% over standard distillation. Overall, it provides a simple yet surprisingly effective framework to learn efficient test-time exploration.

papers.title_en: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
papers.authors: Yihao Hu, Zhihao Wen, Yitong Lin, Siyuan Lu, Pan Wang, Wei Wu, Jiang-Ming Yang, Tao Lin
papers.evidence: 为工具使用智能体合成有决策依据的可执行轨迹
papers.tldr: 成功的工具使用轨迹未必是有效监督：它可能缺少关键观察-动作依赖，或包含决策时不可见信息不支持的动作。Trajectory2Gym围绕支持不足的组合结构构造可执行交互，并仅从已实现执行中有依据的决策提取监督。该方法在五个Qwen3规模上均提升Tau1、Tau2和BFCL，三项等权均值提高16.9–29.8个百分点。结果表明，工具智能体的扩展不仅靠收集成功轨迹，更需构造依赖可表示、决策可学习的交互经验。
papers.abstract_en: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.

papers.title_en: A Distribution-Matching Perspective on LLM Training Algorithms
papers.authors: Yanxing Huang, Bingzhang Yan, Zihan Tang, Wenzhe Li, Peng Li, Yang Liu
papers.evidence: 用分布匹配统一分析并论证在线策略蒸馏优于经典知识蒸馏
papers.tldr: 该文从分布匹配视角统一解释现代大语言模型不同阶段的训练算法，将训练目标视为最小化当前模型与目标分布间的散度。作者分析目标分布性质，发现On-Policy Distillation在模型接近目标时优于经典Knowledge Distillation，远离时则相反。当目标分布依赖被优化模型时，估计方差累积会导致目标分布确定性退化，部分解释现有强化学习算法的长期行为。为此提出Conditional KL正则，在缓解目标退化的同时保持模式多样性并放宽对奖励提升的KL约束。
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspective of distribution matching. We show that a broad class of language model training algorithms can be interpreted as minimizing a certain divergence between the current model and a target distribution, and that characterizing the properties of this target distribution provides substantial insight into the behavior of the corresponding training algorithms. By analyzing specific forms of the target distribution, we establish that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) enjoys an advantage over classical Knowledge Distillation (KD) when the current model distribution is close to the target distribution, while exhibiting a disadvantage when the two distributions are far apart. Furthermore, when the target distribution itself depends on the model being optimized, we show that the accumulation of estimation variance can induce a deterministic degradation of the target distribution. These results provide a theoretical explanation, at least in part, for the long-term behavior of existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms. With this intuition we further designed Conditional KL (CKL) regularization for mitigating the degradation of the target distribution. CKL can effectively preserve mode diversity while relaxing the constraint imposed by classical KL regularization on reward improvements. We believe this theoretical perspective can bring some new understanding of language model training algorithms and provide useful guidance for future research.

papers.title_en: Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor Critic for Decentralized LLM Collaboration
papers.authors: Tianle Chen, Shuo Liu, Christopher Amato
papers.evidence: 去中心化LLM协作与多智能体强化学习
papers.tldr: 现有LLM协作优化多依赖预定义工作流，效率与可扩展性受限，而分散式协作中智能体独立执行、通信有限且共享目标。作者提出BCMAAC，用信念条件化的多智能体Actor-Critic方法，维护对上下文信息的信念并用于训练。在Minecraft游戏、网页搜索与工具使用任务上，任务表现与协作行为均优于朴素Actor-Critic基线。多轮且上下文更丰富的任务中，信念建模优势尤为明显。
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), but many approaches still rely on predefined workflows, limiting efficiency and scalability. Decentralized LLM collaboration is challenging because agents execute independently with limited communication, share a joint objective, and must infer useful information from communication traces. In this paper, we propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information and uses them to facilitate training. Experiments on Minecraft game-playing, web searching and tool-using tasks show that BCMAAC improves task performance and collaborative behavior compared to naive actor-critic baselines. The improvements are particularly pronounced in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information, where belief modeling provides a clear advantage.

papers.title_en: CoEvolve: Counterfactual-Guided Co-Evolution of Memory and Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Xufei Shi, Derong Xu, Wei Chen, Yanyu Yao, Zhi Zheng, Tong Xu
papers.evidence: 多智能体系统中记忆与协作的协同演化
papers.tldr: LLM多智能体系统的记忆与协作架构常保持静态，难以持续适应；分别演化两者又可能出现记忆与工作流不匹配。CoEvolve以技能为中心，将可复用局部协作模式表示为技能，连接协作决策与支撑记忆，并用反事实轨迹识别局部演化信号，协同更新技能库、技能记忆和执行器记忆。在ALFWorld与WebShop上取得整体最佳表现，消融验证了对齐共演化与反事实引导的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks. Yet their memory and collaboration architectures often remain static, constraining continued adaptation and improvement over time. Recent work addresses this limitation by evolving memory or collaboration based on interaction experience. However, updates to these interdependent components are not necessarily aligned: an evolved workflow may require experience that memory does not provide, while evolved memory may encode guidance that the workflow cannot use. To address this problem, we propose CoEvolve, a skill-centered framework for aligned memory--collaboration evolution. CoEvolve represents reusable local collaboration patterns as skills that link evolving collaboration decisions to their supporting memories. It further compares original and counterfactual trajectories to identify local evolution signals, which coordinate updates to the skill library, skill memory, and executor memories across rounds. Experiments on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks confirm that CoEvolve achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of aligned co-evolution and counterfactual-guided evolution.

papers.title_en: FOCUS: Active Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Model Agents
papers.authors: Zhengping Jiang, William Jurayj, Liaoyaqi Wang, Chunsheng Zuo, Anqi Liu, Benjamin Van Durme
papers.evidence: 通过评论家信用分配训练长程语言模型智能体的强化学习方法
papers.tldr: 长程语言模型智能体因稀疏结果奖励难以对早期动作进行信用分配，学习型评论家又存在估值不准与重复续采样成本高的问题。FOCUS 通过选择性分支和 rollout 控制器，从预期最能降低评论家误差的状态采样续写，并用 TD(λ) 优势为片段打分。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，BrowseComp-Plus 达 55.4，较最强基线提升 7.2 分；DeonticBench 达 56.5，提升 4.1 分。该方法以模块化上下文管理解耦 rollout 分配，支持长程智能体强化学习。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions. Learned critics provide value estimates for intermediate states, but these estimates can be inaccurate, while estimating intermediate values with repetitive continuation samples from points within a trajectory incurs substantial costs. To mitigate these issues, we introduce FOCUS, an RL method that uses selective branching to help the critic network learn its value estimator. The rollout controller facilitates active learning for the critic by sampling continuations from states that are expected to most reduce the critic's estimation error. These refined value estimates then score the segment between consecutive states with a TD($λ$) advantage, while the sampled evidence supplies training targets for the critic. FOCUS supports long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning through a modular context-management interface that decouples context management from rollout allocation. Our experiments show that using compaction-induced segment boundaries for value estimation and credit assignment, FOCUS outperforms GRPO and VinePPO with matched per-step generation budgets on legal reasoning, deep search, and code localization benchmarks, improving held-out accuracy at Qwen3.5-9B scale by 7.2 points over the strongest baseline on BrowseComp-Plus (55.4 vs. 48.2) and by 4.1 points on DeonticBench (56.5 vs. 52.4).

papers.title_en: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
papers.authors: Minh Pham-Dinh, Md Farhan Ishmam, Hernan Yupanqui, Reaz Hassan Joarder, Kenneth Marino
papers.evidence: 为网页智能体自动生成经校验的技能中心训练数据
papers.tldr: 现有浏览器智能体缺少对可复用交互技能的系统诊断与训练。作者构建含65个网站、369个任务的MiniWeb，标注37个交互原语并归为7类技能，再用MiniWebGen生成技能训练数据。微调Qwen3.5-4B后单原语成功率提升24.9pp，但短时技能不直接等于全任务成功；MiniWebAgent以规划器组合技能，使未见站点任务成功率提升19.4pp，并迁移至多个外部基准。该工作提出“先练技能、再组合”的紧凑浏览器智能体配方。
papers.abstract_en: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.

papers.title_en: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
papers.authors: Chanwoo Park, Jaywoong Jeong, Zachary Wojtowicz, Yubin Kim, Taekyun Lee, Kaiqing Zhang, Asuman Ozdaglar
papers.evidence: 面向分布式信息团队决策的语言模型智能体训练环境
papers.tldr: 现实团队决策需整合分散信息，但AI智能体多在孤立环境中训练评测。TeamGym基于法律、金融、医疗与软件工程语料构建团队决策环境，并提出可识别“关键信息”的最小事实集，以控制信息分布并追踪整合过程。测试8个语言模型发现，分散关键信息使成功率平均下降22.9个百分点，需自行检索时再降19.9个百分点。用团队决策损失做强化学习可提升最终决策质量，并涌现参与、发言选择与沟通协调。
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap). We also document that participants do not effectively retrieve decision-relevant information on their own: A team's success rate is lowered by a further 19.9 points when participants must identify and extract pivotal information from source material rather than receiving it directly (a retrieval gap). To help remedy these deficits, we use TeamGym to train policies through reinforcement learning on team decision loss. Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.

papers.title_en: A Comprehensive Framework for All Stages of Large-Model Training: From Data and Tokenization, through Pretraining, to Post-Training Alignment
papers.authors: Xiangjing An, Zhibin Jiao, Aiting Chen
papers.evidence: 统一覆盖数据、预训练与后训练阶段的大模型训练框架
papers.tldr: 现有大模型训练综述多聚焦单一阶段或技术，缺乏统一阶段划分与横向可比框架。本文提出覆盖数据、目标函数、优化策略、系统约束、评估与风险治理的六维框架，梳理2017—2026年395篇文献并绘制跨阶段效应图。关键发现：缩放律可比性依赖数据质量与配比；RLHF、DPO与可验证奖励强化学习重塑后训练边界，Pass@1与Pass@K之争未决；多模态对分词器、目标和评估构成挑战。并给出方法族图谱、决策树和10余个开放问题，为分阶段子综述提供可扩展骨架。
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) arise from the synergy of the full training pipeline, including data and tokenization, pretraining, and post-training (supervised fine-tuning, preference alignment, reinforcement learning, and continual optimization), rather than any individual stage. Existing surveys mostly adopt a single-stage or single-technique perspective, treating related research as isolated systems without unified stage division or a horizontally comparable basis.   This paper proposes a unified stage division and a six-dimensional analytical framework covering data, objective function, optimization strategy, system constraints, evaluation, and risk and governance. We systematically review 395 core references from 2017 to 2026, and present a conceptual map of cross-stage effects: forward constraints of pretraining on post-training, and reverse empowerment of post-training on data and pretraining.   We derive three core findings. First, the comparability of scaling laws depends on data quality and mixture, a long-neglected variable. Second, preference alignment methods (RLHF, DPO) and reasoning reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards redefine post-training boundaries, while the Pass@1 versus Pass@K debate remains unresolved. Third, multimodal training poses structural challenges to the pure-text paradigm in tokenizer design, training objectives, and evaluation.   The paper provides a cross-stage effects diagram, a method-family map, a practical decision tree, and at least 10 verifiable open problems, with an extensible skeleton for focused sub-surveys per stage. As of the retrieval date, peer-reviewed evidence (A+B) accounts for approximately 79% of the 395 references.

papers.title_en: Holding a Steady Course: Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons for Continual Agent Learning
papers.authors: Wenzhe Fan, Benjamin Steenhoek, Gaurav Mittal, Yu Hu
papers.evidence: 将智能体经验整理为可复用技能与纠正教训
papers.tldr: 自主智能体在连续相关任务中常难以保留并改进知识，且自动积累的技能与记忆可能传播错误。KEEL以验证器证据把成功行为提炼为可复用技能、把失败转化为纠正教训，并随新证据支持、反驳、替换或淘汰技能声明。在SkillFlow上，其任务成功率较无知识基线提升4.2至21.7个百分点，高于默认方法的2.4至9.6个百分点。结果表明，持续学习的关键在于持续验证和演化知识，而非单纯积累经验。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time. Existing approaches convert interaction trajectories into memories or reusable skills, but experience is not automatically reliable knowledge. Automatically collected skills and memories can propagate errors, mislead, and corrupt useful knowledge. To address this gap, we introduce Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons (KEEL), an agent-agnostic framework that uses verifier evidence to transform successful behavior into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons. As new evidence accumulates, individual skill claims can be supported, contradicted, replaced, or retired. On SkillFlow benchmark, KEEL improves task success by 4.2 to 21.7 percentage points over the no-knowledge baseline, compared with gains of 2.4 to 9.6 points from SkillFlow's default method. Ablations show that skills and lessons are complementary. These results show that reliable continual agent learning depends not simply on accumulating experience, but on continually validating and evolving the knowledge derived from it. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/KEEL-TTCL26.

papers.title_en: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Yalun Wu, Qiwei Ma, Bingbing Xu, Dan Zhang, Long Bai, Boyang Wang, Jiatong Li, Zheqi Lv, Shaozu Yuan, Peiying Wang, Jiawei Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua
papers.evidence: 去中心化多智能体自演化与跨智能体协作
papers.tldr: 去中心化多智能体系统需在测试时适应伙伴并复用经验，但现有方法多只针对单一交互场景。EvolveMAS为每个主智能体配备MemoryAgent，在推理上下文外维护结构化记忆，并联合片段内在线适应与跨片段知识演化。它在五类基准六种配置上取得77.2的最高归一化均分，消融验证记忆治理与知识复用均有效。该工作实现了不更新模型参数的经验驱动自演化。
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized multi-agent systems (MAS) enable large language model agents to interact without centralized control. Agents need to adapt to other agents at test time and reuse accumulated experience to refine their interaction strategies for future interactions across cooperative, mixed-motive, and adversarial settings. However, existing approaches often develop adaptation mechanisms for particular interaction settings. This raises a central question: how can decentralized MAS support test-time adaptation and reliable experience reuse across interaction settings? We propose EvolveMAS, a unified self-evolution framework that supports experience-driven adaptation within and across episodes. EvolveMAS pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent for test-time memory governance, which maintains isolated Structured Memory outside the main agent's reasoning context. EvolveMAS organizes adaptation into two complementary processes: Within-Episode Online Adaptation and Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution. During Within-Episode Online Adaptation, MemoryAgent updates episodic, semantic, and working memory from interaction evidence to inform subsequent actions. During Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution, the main agent uses memory and episode outcomes to distill reusable interaction knowledge comprising partner profiles and interaction strategies for subsequent episodes. Across five benchmarks and six evaluation configurations spanning the three interaction settings, EvolveMAS achieves the highest normalized average score of 77.2 among the compared methods. Ablations show that test-time memory governance and cross-episode knowledge reuse both improve performance. Interaction traces further illustrate how updated memory and distilled knowledge guide subsequent interactions. These results support experience-driven adaptation in decentralized MAS without updating model parameters.
